scope: ManuscriptRelease edition binding, explicit lifecycle transitions and DeliveryProof-gated delivery
red: A download or file presence could be mistaken for a delivered release.
A release could skip directly from draft to delivered without author approval or current proof.
green: ManuscriptRelease is immutable and bound to EditionManifest and CanonCommit fingerprint.
Linear lifecycle transitions reject skipped states.
frozen and delivered require explicit author approval; delivered additionally requires current DeliveryProof.
apiCommand: npm.cmd --prefix api test -- src/app.spec.ts -t "freezes and reads a publication edition"
boundary: State machine and API evidence are local; production rollout approval and external delivery remain separate gates.
